data.name: Mahbuba
data.gender_notes: Mahbuba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'mahabbah', meaning 'love'. Often used to refer to someone dearly loved or adored. The name Mahbuba carries the meaning “Beloved, Adored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahbuba usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, adored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahbuba refers to a deeply devoted and loving servant of God, reflecting the Hadith: 'None of you will believe until you love for your brother what you love for yourself.' (Al-Bukhari and Muslim)
data.etymology: Mahbuba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Adored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahbuba total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: محبوبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم محبوبة يدل على الشخصية المحبوبة والمحمية عند الله تعالى، مشتق من الفعل 'حب' الذي يعني الحب والمودة، ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق المحبة الإلهية والمودة بين المؤمنين، يستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية كدلالة على الحب الإلهي والرضا

in_urdu.name: محبوبة
in_urdu.meaning: محبوبہ یعنی پسندیدہ اور محفوظ شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محبوبہ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پسندیدہ اور محفوظ، اسلامی روایت میں محبت اور احترام کا اظہار کرتا ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس کا استعمال تاریخی و ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے
